datasets.role: line survey, regions, moment maps, wings

recipe.description: Line list: Splatalogue (CDMS+JPL) via astroquery for the rest ranges 164.4-179.8, 251.2-268.1, 341.9-357.3 GHz, curated species + hydrogen RRLs from the Rydberg formula
Continuum survey of all 2D pbcor images: peaks >5 sigma, positions, rms (MAD)
Spectra extraction from all pbcor cubes: N, S nominal pixels, beam aperture (diameter = geometric-mean FWHM), r=2.5" and r=8" flux densities, cube-peak pixel
Systemic velocity from HCN/HCO+ first moments and half-maximum midpoints
Blind boxcar scan (300 and 100 km/s) at 5 sigma, forced photometry of all catalogue lines, overview and zoom plots; identification at |dv|<60 km/s with plausibility tiers
Moment maps (core |v|<350, blue -400..-150, red 150..400 km/s, mom1 3-sigma clipped), peak finding (>8 sigma, >=1 beam apart) to define regions

Region spectra (peak pixel within 0.6" of the nominal position, beam aperture), 1- and 2-Gaussian fits (scipy curve_fit, constant baseline, noise from line-free channels, lag-1 correlation inflation), integrated intensity |v|<350 with empirical box-sum noise, Tb (Rayleigh-Jeans)
Weak lines by matched filter with same-region HCN/HCO+ templates (limits 3 sigma); CS/H2CS/29SiO NNLS blend model; H13CN on CO wing

Round 2: wing reality tests, unified line table with template-matched integrated intensities and error budgets, spatial scatter tests, region velocities, continuum catalogue/common beam/alpha, cross-OUS check

Xb4d (0.94x0.74") S: I=0.019+-0.017, 3sigma UL 0.050; spatial test at Xb4d spatial test 3.1 sigma (field MAD 0.021, 0.029% of 10247 field pixels >= value); Xb4b S 0.022+-0.007. results.value: Templates are line-specific (each line from its own Xb4d 3-2 cube; round 1 already did this - the reviewer's single-template concern was a misreading of s31), convolved to the target beam; model = N + S + Ext + flat zero level + 20" Gaussian, all signed; chi2_red remains 9-99 (HCN 9-31, HCO+ 47-99): the zone-template model is only an approximation, errors are inflated by chi2_red and by the pixel correlation, and template systematics from 150 bootstrap draws (shifts +-0.3", N/S split +-1", Ext scale +-10%, fit radius +-2") are small (f scatter 0.03-0.1, ladder 0.02-0.05) compared with the fit errors. Ext is unconstrained (errors 0.5-2.4 on f, allowed negative). R_J (Jy ratio, zone-template R_3 N 0.558, S 0.375 included): 10" J=2-1: N 0.64+-0.12, S 0.46+-0.08; 10" J=4-3: N 0.46+-0.14, S 0.35+-0.14; 6.5" J=4-3: N 0.46+-0.07, S 0.35+-0.07 (template-shape +-0.01-0.02 only). S/N R ratio: 2-1 0.71+-0.17, 3-2 0.67 (template), 4-3 0.75+-0.17 (6.5"): S is lower than N at every J, but the N-S coefficient correlation is +0.4 to +0.85 (positive here because the signed model absorbs the common level). Zone ladder ratios f(J)/f(Xb4f 3-2) at 10" [Jy km/s; x2.25 for T_b(2-1)/T_b(3-2), x0.56 for T_b(4-3)/T_b(3-2)]: 2-1/3-2 N HCN 0.79+-0.14, HCO+ 0.72+-0.15; S HCN 0.96+-0.22, HCO+ 0.90+-0.18 -> brightness-temperature ladder r21=T(2-1)/T(3-2) = 1.8/1.6 (N), 2.2/2.0 (S) (>1: sub-thermal 3-2, or 3-2 missing flux); 4-3/3-2 N HCN 0.81+-0.20 HCO+ 1.02+-0.27, S 0.74+-0.28/0.93+-0.28 -> T(4-3)/T(3-2) = 0.45/0.57 (N), 0.41/0.52 (S) (6.5": N 0.48/0.62, S 0.43/0.52; errors +-0.1). Injection test (truth = unclipped templates, different split and N shifted 0.3", known f, bowl, real correlated noise): J=2 true N,S f=0.8,0.5 recovered 0.97+-0.01, 0.75+-0.02 (+21%, +50% bias); J=4 true 0.5,0.3 recovered 0.51+-0.02, 0.35+-0.03 (+3%, +17%): the S coefficient is biased high relative to N by 10-25% when the real morphology differs from the template, adopted as a +-15-25% systematic on R_J(S)/R_J(N) (the bias is common to both lines and partly cancels in R_J itself). N zone R values are zone averages (include the bridge and the extended gas) and are not comparable to the native-resolution nuclear values (N 0.88).
results.uncertainty: stat+misfit as above, template +-0.01-0.05, model bias (injection) 15-25% on S/N; the cross-band flux scale (10-35%) applies to the ladder ratios but cancels in R_J

results.quantity: HCN/HCO+ 3-2 ratio in the blue-wing blob (Sblue, S nucleus + (-0.2",-1.85"), outflow side): calibrated significance, robustness, replication, null tests
results.target: Sblue, wing -400..-150 km/s, Xb4d native 0.94x0.74", aperture r=0.75" (0.5-1.0" give the same)
results.value: Wing fluxes HCN 0.449+-0.062 (7.3 sigma), HCO+ 0.320+-0.060 (5.3 sigma) Jy km/s/beam; R_wing=1.40; posterior (truncated Gaussians, flat prior) median 1.40, 68% 1.12-1.79, 95% 0.90-2.35; P(R>1)=0.93, P(R>1.2)=0.75. Core at the same position R=0.55+-0.13 -> R_wing-R_core median 0.86, 95% one-sided lower limit +0.36 (P(wing>core)=0.999). Null: 0/400 random line-free positions have both wings >3 sigma (aperture noise 0.062/0.060, HCN-HCO+ noise correlation 0.00); at the bright positions N, S, Bridge, E1, E2 neither wing exceeds 3 sigma in both lines (S: HCN +2.2, HCO+ +2.8 sigma, R 0.8; N none), so core leakage does not create such a wing; only two regions in the field (r<15") have both wings >4 sigma: Sblue (R=1.46) and a small one 14.5" E of N (R=1.42, at PB~0.4). Robustness: the ratio depends on the window: -400..-150 1.40, -450..-150 1.46, -500..-150 1.37, -300..-200 1.40+-0.4, but -350..-100 gives 1.02+-0.18 because core HCO+ leaks in at -150..-100; 50 km/s bins (Jy km/s/beam HCN|HCO+): -400..-350 0.050|0.024, -350..-300 0.085|0.033, -300..-250 0.088|0.072, -250..-200 0.109|0.069, -200..-150 0.116|0.122, -150..-100 0.116|0.210 -> R(v) rises monotonically with blueshift (0.55 at core, ~1 at -200..-150, 1.3-2.6 at -300..-250 and beyond, each bin only 1-3 sigma): the wing is a velocity-dependent HCN excess rather than a distinct constant-R component. Centre shifts +-0.2": 1.30-1.50; +-0.4": 1.19-1.64. REPLICATION IS WEAK: Xb4b (0.25") convolved to the Xb4d beam, same aperture, window -450..-150: HCN 0.259+-0.060, HCO+ 0.302+-0.054, R=0.86+-0.25 (Xb4d same window 1.46+-0.38; difference 0.6+-0.45, 1.3 sigma); HCN in Xb4b is only 53% of Xb4d (2.5 sigma: HCN wing flux partly resolved out/extended) while HCO+ is 91%. Xb4f (5.7x3.5", r=2.5", blended with S core) R=0.83+-0.25 (HCN 0.39+-0.10, HCO+ 0.47+-0.10). So R_wing>R_core is robust in Xb4d (>3 sigma), R_wing>1 is 93% in Xb4d but is not confirmed by the independent array: adopt R_wing = 1.0-1.5 (best 1.2+-0.4 combining Xb4d and Xb4b-smoothed) i.e. HCN/HCO+ ~2 times the S-core 0.38-0.55 but not clearly >1. p0001's 1.8 'peak-pixel' bias: injection into real noise patches gives no bias (peak-pixel R median 1.40 for true 1.40, 1.39 for 1.39, 1.00 for 1.00; scatter 16-84% +-0.25-0.4), so the claim that the peak-pixel recipe is biased high is dropped; p0001's 1.8 differs from our aperture value mostly by window/aperture. Neighbouring lines: window of HCN 3-2 (263.55-263.78 GHz observed): HDO 2(2,0)-3(1,3) (Eup 157 K, logA -4.8), CH3OH 2(-2)-2(0)E2 (33 K, logA -8.9, negligible), c-C3H/l-C3H, CH3CHO (E>400 K); HCO+ window (265.21-265.43): 13CH3CN 15(7)-14(7) (453 K), SO2 28(4,24)-28(3,25) (416 K), CH3CHO (109-464 K): no strong candidate, but an HDO/c-C3H contribution to the HCN wing cannot be excluded without a second HCN-line check (spectra: out/s38_spectra.png/txt). Consequences (tentative): RADEX LVG (n 1e5-1e7, Tk 20-200 K, thin and tau~1): R_K(3-2) per unit abundance ratio A=N(HCN)/N(HCO+) is 0.08-0.15 (n=1e5), 0.15-0.45 (1e6), 0.46-1.0 (1e7); the core R_K=0.55 needs A=1.5-2.3 at n=1e6 (Tk 50-100 K) or 0.6-0.8 at n=1e7; the wing R_K=1.42 needs A=3.8-6 (n=1e6) or 1.4-2.1 (n=1e7, Tk>=50 K). If excitation is the same as the core the abundance ratio must be 2.6x higher (1.42/0.55); if instead the wing gas is denser/hotter (R(A=1) rises from 0.33 at n=1e6, 100 K to 0.86 at 1e7) a factor ~2.6 in R is reproduced without abundance change. Excitation and abundance are degenerate with 3-2 only. An abundance enhancement would be consistent with shock/high-T neutral-neutral HCN production (Nishimura+2024 outflow HCN/HCO+ enhancement) and contrasts with the absence of an enhancement at the AGN nucleus (Harada+2018).
results.uncertainty: stat from 400 random-position aperture scatter; aperture centre +-0.2" gives +-0.1; window choice +-0.4 (-350..-100 gives 1.0); Xb4b replication 0.86+-0.25; 5% HCN-vs-HCO+ calibration

interpretation: The survey finds that the spectral content of the dataset is dominated by only a handful of lines: HCN and HCO+ 2-1/3-2/4-3 (very high S/N at both nuclei), CS 7-6 (N 15 sigma, S 7.5 sigma, Xb47), a CH3OH J_-1-J_0 E blend in Band 5, and the blue wing of CO 3-2 at the Xb47 spw20 edge. Everything else (SO 5_6-4_5, the 254.015 GHz CH3OH line, HC3N 28-27, HC15N, SO 8_8-7_7, HCN-vib, H13CN) is absent or only marginal, so shock/chemistry diagnostics beyond CS, HCN/HCO+ ratios and CH3OH will be limits (Q4, Q5). The proposal's SO(6_5-5_4) is not in the data. The system is resolved at 0.25-1": N (double-horned, broad, extended continuum), S (compact continuum, line centre ~65 km/s blueward of systemic, narrower), a narrow Bridge component 1.4" S of N, two eastern clumps (E1, E2, redshifted 50-90 km/s), a western clump, and a blue-shifted blob (Sblue) 3" S-SW of S with a broad (120-230 km/s) blue-shifted profile and a blue wing; the S nucleus itself has a 4-9% blue wing. These match the picture of a dense-gas outflow near the S nucleus, but the high-velocity channels are outside the clean mask, so wing fluxes are lower limits/dirty. N and S are cleanly separable at Bands 6-7 (beam minor axes 2.7-3.5" << 5.2") and only partially in Band 5. HCN/HCO+ at matched J is already a regional discriminator (N 0.6-1.0, S 0.4-0.5 at J=3-2); this is handed to Q1 together with matched-beam convolution. The delivered mfs/cont images are line-free. ROUND 2: The S blue wing and the elongated (~2", ~0.4 kpc) blue-wing structure south of S are real (8-19 sigma vs empirical noise, reproduced by an independent array, not a sidelobe copy of S/N); this is the only dense-gas outflow candidate in the data and supports regional comparisons for S vs its wing, but with uncleaned (lower-limit) fluxes. N and S have different line-centre velocities (N-S +71 km/s), so a single systemic velocity is not appropriate. Of the weak lines only CH3OH (J=1-3 E blend, cold/sub-thermal, Trot<~11 K) and probably HOC+ 2-1 (HCO+/HOC+~37-50, N+S blend) are secure; SO 5_6-4_5 (blended with CH3OH) and HC3N are unconfirmed at the 2-4 sigma level against baseline scatter; the former '253.9 GHz feature' is CH3OH 2(0)-1(-1)E (254.015 GHz), detected at the Bridge (off-nuclear) with Tex~10 K (8-21 K) from the ratio to the J=1-3 blend. Continuum spectral index alpha(B5-B7)~1.5+-0.2 once beams and aperture are matched. Q1 (HCN/HCO+ at matched J, round 2): HCN/HCO+ is lower at the AGN-hosting S nucleus than at N at every J (3-2 at 0.25": N 0.97-1.03, S 0.43-0.48; at 0.94": 0.86-0.88 vs 0.40; 6.5" blended 0.54 vs 0.39; deblended S/N 0.7+-0.2 at 2-1, 3-2 and 4-3), so there is no HCN/HCO+ enhancement at the S nucleus (agreeing with Harada+2018). The N ratio rises smoothly inward (0.39 at 2-3" to 0.97 at r<0.25"), the S ratio is flat at 0.37-0.43 from 0.25" to 3": a compact HCN-bright core in N, not S. R falls ~25% per J step at 6-10" (within-band; ladder flux slopes carry 25-35% cross-band systematics). Disk: only J=2-1 gives a usable off-nuclear ring (8-12": 0.49+-0.03(+-0.1 sys) vs 0.56 inside 8"); the earlier 0.30 was a negative-bowl artefact; at 3-2 and 4-3 the annuli beyond 8" are unusable. The one enhancement candidate is the blue-wing blob 1.9" S of S: HCN/HCO+ 1.4 (68% 1.1-1.8) at -400..-150 km/s vs 0.55 at the same position's core (R_wing>R_core at >3 sigma, window-robust), rising with blueshift, but the independent Xb4b replication gives 0.86+-0.25 and R_wing>1 is not established (tentative). With 3-2 alone excitation (n>=1e7 or T) and abundance (x2.6) are degenerate; an enhancement would resemble shock chemistry (Nishimura+2024). Q1 (HCN/HCO+ at matched J): the ratio at matched beam is lower at the AGN-hosting S nucleus than at N at every J (3-2 at 0.25": N 1.03, S 0.48; at 6.5": 0.54 vs 0.39; 4-3 at 6.5": 0.43 vs 0.32; deblended S/N ~0.6-0.75 at 2-1, 3-2 and 4-3), and falls ~25% per J step everywhere (midpoint 0.58, 0.45, 0.33 at 10"), so there is no HCN/HCO+ enhancement at the S nucleus, agreeing with Harada+2018. The only enhancement candidate is the blue-wing blob (see above): R_wing>R_core is robust, R_wing>1 is not replicated; team-a's full-window 0.75+-0.06 is a core-dominated window of the same data (injection tests show no peak-pixel bias), and team-a p0004 independently agrees on N/S, the 2-1 disk ratio (0.47-0.50 vs 0.56-0.62) and the wing. The N-nucleus ratio >1 at 0.25" is a compact HCN-bright core. Ladder ratios alone allow A=N(HCN)/N(HCO+) from <1 (n>=3e6) to ~4 (n~1e4-1e5): abundance versus excitation is undecided without H13CN.
caveats: Formal errors are supplemented by an empirical baseline term (template slid over line-free channels) and spatial field scatter for tentative lines; flux-scale (5% B6, 10% B5/B7) and a 12 m Gaussian primary-beam term (5-10% for pb<0.9) are added only in the sig_cal column and in the text of the budgeted entries; absolute pb accuracy at E1/E2/W was not measured.

Single-Gaussian parameters (centroid, FWHM) are INVALID where chi2r>>1 (N and S at all resolutions: double-horned/two-component profiles, chi2r 2-20): such rows are flagged in the report; use the integrated intensity (template/sum) or the 2G components.

A single systemic velocity is not applicable: N 2792+-19, S 2721+-21 km/s (N-S offset +71+-28), midpoint ~2756; the 2780 km/s of round 1 is the blended low-resolution centre. Weak-line templates/windows are per region.

Wings and the Sblue structure are real in two independent arrays (Xb4d, Xb4b convolved) but lie outside the clean mask: fluxes are lower limits, with a sidelobe/missing-flux systematic <=0.01-0.02 Jy/beam km/s; the Xb4b HCN test has no power against sidelobes on its own.

SO 5_6-4_5 (blended with the CH3OH A-type ladder, flux an upper limit) and HC3N 28-27 are unconfirmed; the 254 GHz feature is CH3OH 2(0)-1(-1)E (identified by velocity, round 4); single-beam (Xb4f) significance of SO/HC3N drops from 5.0/3.8 sigma to 2.8/2.0 sigma against the spatial scatter, and the non-detection at 1" and 0.25" is non-diagnostic because beam dilution of a smooth source would put the signal below the limits.

Continuum: 0.24" and 0.94" arrays resolve out extended flux (48%/68% of the 5.8" flux at B6), so comparisons of flux or alpha across OUS must use matched beams and are image-plane only; the defensible alpha(B5-B7)=1.5+-0.2 (+-0.5 systematic).
Line IDs from Splatalogue rest frequencies; blends with separation < line width (HCN v2=1, CS/H2CS/29SiO, CH3OH J=1-3, H13CN/CO) are degenerate; H13CN opacity cannot be measured from these data.
Distance 40 Mpc (literature) is assumed for pc conversions; literature outflow geometry (Michiyama+2018, Pereira-Santaella+2024) is quoted from abstracts only.

Literature: Michiyama+2018 (arXiv:1810.04821) abstract verified via arXiv API (outflow from S nucleus; N no detection); distance 40 Mpc (Pereira-Santaella+2024) and Nishimura+2024 were taken from earlier notes and not re-verified; the HOC+ literature ratios (Harada+2018 2018ApJ...855...49H, Usero+2004) could NOT be verified and were removed. CH3OH excitation is model dependent (blend degenerate; 30% window/template systematic).

CH3OH is the only weak molecule with an off-nuclear signature: the 254.015 GHz line is detected at the Bridge in Xb4d (9.9 sigma matched filter, 3.4 sigma fixed-window moment) and absent at the N and S nuclei (Xb4d 3 sigma UL 0.12 Jy/beam km/s); line identification by velocity is relative to HCO+ 3-2 in the same pixel with a 10 km/s systematic floor, one transition only. The 254/J=1-3 ratio gives LTE Tex 8-21 K (S), thin, same filling assumed.

Q1r2: Disk HCN/HCO+ is measurable only at J=2-1 (Xb55) out to ~12" (PB model >=0.5, annulus flux positive); the zero level of every array is not flat (positive far field, negative 17-24" ring), so the 8-12" ratio has a ~+-0.1 systematic; 3-2 and 4-3 disk ratios are unconstrained (degenerate between missing short spacings and low excitation).

Q1r2: The zone-template deblend still has chi2_red 9-99 and a 15-25% S-vs-N model bias in injection; Ext zone is unconstrained; N and S values at 10" are model-dependent and S/N=0.7+-0.2 should not be sharpened. The T_b ladder ratios r21~1.6-2.2 (>1) mix cross-band flux scales (10-35%) with possible missing 3-2 flux and are not thermometers without Q3 modelling.

Q1r2: Sblue wing: R_wing>R_core is robust in Xb4d but the Xb4b-smoothed replication (0.86+-0.25; HCN wing only 53% recovered) does not confirm R>1; window choice (-350..-100) gives 1.0; weak neighbouring lines (HDO, c-C3H, CH3OH) lie in the HCN window and are not excluded.
